patch_description: The validation failure was occurring before strategy logic was even evaluated: the evaluator could not import the generated program, resulting in `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'loader'` from `importlib.util.module_from_spec(...)`. To make the program reliably importable and valid, I preserved the required `EVOLVE-BLOCK` markers, kept the same function signature/output schema, and simplified/strengthened the signal logic to be robust to missing or malformed context values. The updated function uses only in-scope values at bar close, adds guarded feature parsing, asymmetric long/short thresholds, volatility-adjusted sizing and exits, and avoids any lookahead.
